subject: R1 10 11 12 13 still unpublished
body:
FACT: live R1 CANON_BLUEPRINT 10/11/12/13 are still the 2026-09-15 files. AGENT_C worktree has locked wording on branch_agent_c HEAD 0cb23dd6ce01ede82de763447a849e289deeb1f5. A will not merge branch_agent_c. A closes the C OPEN_CONTRADICTIONS ledger rows only after these files appear on R1 CANON_BLUEPRINT with that locked wording.

Live R1 paths (filesystem mtime 2026-09-15T18:16:04Z; still version 1.1-candidate):
- 10_LEARNING_AND_STRATEGY.md last_modified 2026-09-16T08:34:00+07:00
  [10.1] ACT | Execute a physical action via actuator
  [10.3] episode recorded [11] then FEM    Q* update  SPEAR  Skill candidate
- 11_FAILURE_EXPERIENCE_MEMORY.md last_modified 2026-09-16T08:36:00+07:00
  still 1.1-candidate; no S11.13 FailureRecord 128-bit candidate budget
- 12_SKILL_AND_TEACHING.md last_modified 2026-09-16T08:38:00+07:00
  [12.1] SkillRecord lists cost_stats / success_count / failure_count with no utility-only / not-proof caveat
- 13_INFORMATION_NEURONALIZATION.md last_modified 2026-09-16T08:40:00+07:00
  [13.2] Working memory | Temporary activated/bound state in T1 BRAM
  [13.2] Long-term memory | Persistent graph in T2 DDR
  [13.3] TYPE, ID, ROLE are independent
  [13.7] I CAN EXPRESS UNKNOWN / CONFLICT / INCOMPLETE

C worktree wording (not live R1; A does not copy C files):
- [10.1] ACT | Emit an ACTION_INTENT into the locked action path [01.7, 05]; never drives an actuator itself
- [10.3] EPISODE recorded (general experience memory); FEM* ingress only if failure-relevant
- [12.1] success_count, failure_count, cost_stats are utility/execution statistics only
- [13.2] Working memory | Working state — a logical cognitive class; T1 is only its typical placement
- [13.7] I CAN EXPRESS UNKNOWN / CONFLICT / SEARCH_INCOMPLETE

C 064701 claimed APPLIED on the branch. That is not R1 publish. Three (or four) files: 10, 12, 13 required; 11 is the fourth.
